author: Chippewa Valley Times
title: UW-Stout launches seventh annual Giving Day with matching gift opportunity
text:
Katherine P. Frank, Chancellor | University of Wisconsin-Stout
Katherine P. Frank, Chancellor | University of Wisconsin-Stout
The University of Wisconsin-Stout will hold its seventh annual Giving Day campaign on Tuesday, December 2. The event aims to raise $500,000 to support the university's strategic priorities and community. Organized by the UW-Stout Foundation & Alumni Association, the campaign encourages alumni, friends, and supporters to contribute to the StoutProud Fund or designate their gifts to specific areas of interest within UW-Stout.
A group of alumni and friends has created a matching gift opportunity for this year’s Giving Day. All donations made during the event will be matched, effectively doubling each contribution's impact.
Last year’s Giving Day surpassed its $300,000 goal with over 800 gifts and pledges totaling $476,455. Funds raised help provide scholarships and financial aid, support holistic student services, advance academic innovation through faculty-led research and collaboration, create modern living and learning spaces on campus, and invest in campus life and athletics.
“Support of gifts through the StoutProud Fund will: Remove barriers to education through scholarships and financial aid. Provide robust support for students through holistic wraparound services to meet students where they are, support their Stout journeys, and foster their success. Advance academic innovation and success through faculty-driven innovation, research and community collaboration. Create state-of-the-art living and learning spaces through the development of environments that foster innovation, academic collaboration and a welcoming home away from home. Ensure a vibrant campus life and athletics through investing in students’ experiences to enhance engagement, belonging and school spirit,” according to information from UW-Stout.
Donations can be made online or mailed directly to the UW-Stout Foundation & Alumni Association at 320 S. Broadway St., Menomonie, WI 54751.
Participants are encouraged to share their involvement using #StoutProud on social media platforms associated with both the university and its Alumni Association for updates about Giving Day activities.
UW-Stout is part of the Universities of Wisconsin system with an emphasis on applied learning in partnership with business and industry sectors as outlined in its FOCUS2030 strategic plan (https://www.uwstout.edu/about-us/our-strategic-plan).
For more details about participating in Giving Day or making a donation, visit https://www.uwstout.edu/giving-day.
